fields.place_of_incident: Azad Nagar, near the post office

narrative: My name is Shri Rajesh Qureshi. I live at the above address with my family, and I work as a teacher.
On 31 December 2024 at about 8:25 PM, we locked the house and went to visit relatives in a nearby village.
When we came back, I saw that the lock of the main door was broken.
Someone had taken gold ornaments and cash worth Rs 30,000/- from the steel almirah in the bedroom.
The back door of the house was found open.
According to my neighbour, Ashok Saxena was seen near my house that evening.
Ashok Saxena left on a black motorcycle bearing number ZZ 16 RS 5994.
That night, the street lights in the area were working.
I had told the accused earlier to stay away from my family.
The place where it happened, near the post office, is usually busy.
I am giving this in my own words, and it has been read over to me.
Please keep my identity and address safe.
I will give full cooperation to the investigation.
I came to the police station as soon as I could to report the matter.
I have not seen the accused after the incident.
My brother was with me at that time.
I had seen the accused near my house a few days before the incident, on a Sunday.
Some people from the locality gathered at the spot after hearing the noise.
My family is very afraid after this incident.
I will be able to recognise the accused if I see him again.
I request you to register a case and take strict action against the accused.

My mobile phone, worth Rs. 36,000.00, fell and broke during the attack.

The street lights in the area were working that night.

I reached the police station at the earliest to report this matter.
I have never given money or property to the accused before.
There is a CCTV camera at a shop near the railway crossing, and its footage may help.
I will be able to recognise the accused if I see him again.
Since the incident, I have not seen the accused.
The accused is known to me, and he lives in the same locality.
I request you to register a case and take strict action against the accused.

fields.place_of_incident: Gandhi Colony, near the water tank
fields.complainant_address: House No. 37, Nehru Park Extension, Chandoli

narrative: I, Prakash Sharma, live at the above address with my family and work as a farmer.
At around 2:50 PM on 5th Sep 2024, I was walking home from work near the water tank.
Raghav Bhatt stopped me and started abusing me over an old dispute about a water connection.
He struck my left arm with a brick, and I fell to the ground.
He did say that he would kill me if I went to the police.
During the attack, my mobile phone worth Rs 14,500/- fell and was broken.
He ran away on a scooter bearing number ZZ-33-LM-4376.
Some people from the locality gathered at the spot after hearing the noise.
At that time, my brother was with me.
That night, the street lights in the area were working.
I came to the police station as soon as I could to report the matter.
Please keep my identity and address safe.
I will give full cooperation to the investigation.
There is a CCTV camera at a shop near the water tank, and its footage may help.
I had seen the accused near my house a few days before the incident, on a Friday.
I have never given money or property to the accused before.
I request that a case be registered and that strict action be taken against the accused.

narrative: I, Shri Raghav Sharma, live at the above address with my family and work as a shopkeeper.
At around 15.50 hrs on 5th Sep 2025, I left my red motorcycle, number ZZ-20-GH-9556, parked near the public library.
About twenty minutes later, I came back and found that the motorcycle was gone.
The value of the motorcycle is about Rs 76,401/-.
A nearby shopkeeper said that Sanjay Joshi was seen pushing the motorcycle towards the main road.
I had locked the handle of the motorcycle before leaving.
I request that my identity and address be kept safe.
A few days before the incident, on a Sunday, I had seen the accused near my house.
I came to the police station as soon as I could to report the matter.
I am giving this in my own words, and it has been read over to me.
Some people from the locality gathered at the spot after hearing the noise.
The accused lives in the same locality, and he is known to me.
My family is very afraid after this incident.
I will be able to recognise the accused if I see him again.
Earlier, I had asked the accused to stay away from my family.
I request you to register a case and take strict action against the accused.

narrative: I, Shri Yogesh Negi, live at the above address with my family and work as a driver.
On 15th May 2025 at about 08.55 hrs, I was returning home from work near the community hall.
Sandeep Gupta stopped me and started abusing me over an old dispute about a parking space.
He hit me on my left arm with a brick, and I fell down.
He did threaten to kill me if I went to the police.
During the attack, my mobile phone worth Rs. 19000 fell and was broken.
He escaped on a scooter with registration number ZZ-13-RS-4703.
This is in my own words, and it was read over to me.
The place where it happened, near the community hall, is usually busy.
I had seen the accused near my house a few days before the incident, on a Wednesday.
Some people from the locality gathered at the spot after hearing the noise.
The accused is known to me, and he lives in the same locality.
This incident has caused great fear in my family.
I can identify the accused if I see him again.
Earlier, I had asked the accused to stay away from my family.
I have not seen the accused after the incident.
I will cooperate fully with the investigation.
There is a CCTV camera at a shop near the community hall, and its footage may help.
I have not given any money or property to the accused on any earlier occasion.
I came to the police station as soon as I could to report the matter.
I request you to register a case and take strict action against the accused.

fields.place_of_incident: Teachers Colony, near the petrol pump

narrative: My name is Sandeep Rawat. I live at the above address with my family, and I work as a shopkeeper.
At around 13:20 on 03-03-2025, I was walking home from work near the petrol pump.
Ramesh Joshi stopped me there and abused me because of an old dispute about a water connection.
He hit me on my back with a wooden stick, and I fell down.
He did threaten to kill me if I went to the police.
My mobile phone, worth Rs. 12,000.00, fell and broke during the attack.
He ran away on a scooter bearing number ZZ-06-JK-3317.
I can identify the accused if I see him again.
I have not given any money or property to the accused on any earlier occasion.
Some people from the locality gathered at the spot after hearing the noise.
A shop near the petrol pump has a CCTV camera, and its footage may be useful.
My family is very afraid after this incident.
I request that my identity and address be kept safe.
That night, the street lights in the area were working.
I had told the accused earlier to stay away from my family.
The accused lives in the same locality, and he is known to me.
A few days before the incident, on a Monday, I had seen the accused near my house.
I came to the police station as soon as I could to report the matter.
My cousin was with me at that time.
The incident took place near the petrol pump, which is a busy area.
I request you to register a case and take strict action against the accused.

The case property is safely kept in the store of the police station.
The call records of the mobile numbers involved were obtained.
A site plan of the place of occurrence was made.
The concerned offices provided the relevant reports.
The witnesses support the version of the complainant.
The incident happened at about 18.35 hrs, according to the witnesses.
Based on the evidence collected, this charge sheet is filed against the accused.

fields.place_of_incident: Gandhi Colony, near the railway crossing
fields.court_name: Court of the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kesarpur

narrative: According to the complainant, Mukesh Gupta, an offence took place at Gandhi Colony, near the railway crossing on 17th Aug 2025.
During investigation, it was found that Gopal Sinha broke the lock, entered the house and stole gold ornaments and cash worth Rs 98,000/-.
Witnesses at the spot identified the accused.
During questioning, the accused did admit his role.
A grey motorcycle bearing number ZZ-35-LM-1328 was seized from the accused.
Statements of witnesses were recorded, and the relevant documents were collected.
During investigation, the seized property was identified by the complainant.
The relevant reports were obtained from the concerned offices.
A site plan of the place of occurrence was made.
The witnesses support the version of the complainant.
The CCTV footage from a shop near the railway crossing was checked.
The investigation was completed within the time allowed.
The accused was arrested and produced before the court.
The call records of the mobile numbers involved were obtained.
The case property is safely kept in the store of the police station.
The incident happened at about 2:15 PM, according to the witnesses.
The accused has no earlier criminal record in Kesarpur, as per available records.
The complainant was examined, and the statement was taken down.
On the basis of the evidence collected, this charge sheet is submitted against the accused.

narrative: I, Suman Sinha, live in Bhavanpur and work as a clerk.
On 7 December 2024 at about 13.45 hrs, I was near the water tank.
I noticed Deepak Bhatt standing close to the complainant's house.
Because the area was well lit, I could see his face clearly.
He went away on a black motorcycle with registration number ZZ13TU9050.
The complainant later told me that property worth Rs 1,82,414/- was involved.
Deepak Bhatt is known to me, as he lives in the same area.
I can identify the accused if I see him again.
I have not seen the accused after the incident.
At that time, my brother was with me.
I have not given any money or property to the accused on any earlier occasion.
After hearing the noise, some local people gathered at the spot.
There is a CCTV camera at a shop near the water tank, and its footage may help.
I will cooperate fully with the investigation.
I request that my identity and address be kept safe.
I am giving this in my own words, and it has been read over to me.
The accused lives in the same locality, and he is known to me.
I have given this statement of my own free will.

narrative: My name is Shri Manoj Rao, and I work as a tailor in Kesarpur.
On 22-03-2026 at about 5:35 PM, I was near the community hall.
I saw Manoj Chauhan pushing a motorcycle towards the main road.
Because the area was well lit, I could see his face clearly.
He went away on a blue motorcycle with registration number ZZ 09 TU 9858.
Later, the complainant told me that property worth Rs. 1,17,000.00 was involved.
Manoj Chauhan is known to me, as he lives in the same area.
This incident has caused great fear in my family.
A shop near the community hall has a CCTV camera, and its footage may be useful.
I will be able to recognise the accused if I see him again.
The accused lives in the same locality, and he is known to me.
I have not given any money or property to the accused on any earlier occasion.
The street lights in the area were working that night.
I had told the accused earlier to stay away from my family.
The incident took place near the community hall, which is a busy area.
I have not seen the accused after the incident.
I will give full cooperation to the investigation.
I had seen the accused near my house a few days before the incident, on a Sunday.
I came to the police station as soon as I could to report the matter.
I have given this statement of my own free will.
